cc:Work.dc:description: Synthetic pinhole camera: 96x78, fx=fy=96.0, cx=47.5, cy=38.5, positive Y down, positive Z forward. Nearest analytic ray-sphere hit for sphere(center=[0.0, 0.0, 3.0], radius=0.8) and plane Z=5.0. Depth stores optical Z, not ray length. Back-projection uses only the depth map. Two triangles per pixel quad. Red faces connect different original objects. Filtering uses only max(Z)-min(Z) <= 0.4, not object labels. Observed surfaces only; no hidden sphere or occluded wall geometry is inserted. All 3D panels share an orthographic camera, light and physical scale.
